entries.name: Name the Weak Point
entries.summary: Read a structure, spell, formation, object, or failing system for the exact weakness whose collapse would matter most, then mark that point for a deliberate Ruin Arcana action. It exposes a real failure path rather than inventing weakness in something truly sound.

entries.name: Narrow Escape
entries.summary: Turn a near miss into a graceful sidestep rather than a desperate stumble. Avoids the worst consequence of one close melee exchange and keeps your footing.

entries.name: Needle Gap
entries.summary: You hook, thrust, and withdraw through tiny openings in armor, shield lines, or monster movement. Can keep a dangerous target at distance while striking specific weak points.

entries.name: Needle Reach
entries.summary: You use reach to touch danger before it reaches you. Use this with spears, tridents, polearms, or long weapons to keep an enemy at distance, interrupt movement, or control a narrow approach.

entries.name: Needle Stone
entries.summary: You use spin, stone choice, and release timing to strike small moving targets such as hands, buckles, lamps, birds, or dangling keys. Enables precise utility shots with simple ammunition.

entries.name: Needleline Shot
entries.summary: You hold aim through breath, tension, and trigger discipline until a narrow shot opens. Use this to fire through cover, movement, or armor gaps that an ordinary hurried shot would miss.

entries.name: Negotiation Position
entries.summary: Anchor a negotiation to your terms by establishing the first concrete position. Shifts the frame of a bargaining conversation in your favor before concessions begin.

entries.name: Nerveflash
entries.summary: Deliver a tightly controlled electrical strike aimed at nerves, muscles, or a conductive contact point rather than raw destruction. Use this to interrupt a precise action, break a grip, stagger a dangerous target, or disable a vulnerable mechanism for a brief moment.

entries.name: Nested Seal
entries.summary: Place a second bounded layer around an existing seal, prison, ward-lock, or contained power so that breaching one condition does not immediately release what lies inside. The added layer must be understood and cannot contain limitless force.

entries.name: Night Covenant
entries.summary: Speak a forbidden working with enough precision that hidden powers must answer the terms instead of merely consuming the petitioner. Forces a dangerous pact, curse, or omen into a defined shape for one scene.

entries.name: Night Fold
entries.summary: Fold darkness around yourself or an ally during a dangerous moment. Conceals one brief action from ordinary sight if the scene has enough shadow.

entries.name: Night Without Distance
entries.summary: You make the shadows of a large scene behave as one connected darkness for movement, concealment, and misdirection. It enables extraordinary repositioning but cannot cross places with no viable shadow or through strong wards.

entries.name: Nightmare Excision
entries.summary: You enter or touch the dream of a willing sleeper and isolate one recurring nightmare, hostile dream-presence, or symbolic loop so it can be confronted, weakened, or separated from the rest of the dream. It does not erase real trauma, memory, or another person's agency.

entries.name: No Soft Exit
entries.summary: Refuse retreat, mercy, concession, or negotiation unless it preserves command strength or creates a better future advantage. Resists retreat, mercy, concession, or manipulation unless it creates real advantage.

entries.name: Noble Pressure Read
entries.summary: Read desperation, ambition, debt, family pressure, and hidden weakness during noble or elite negotiation. Reveals the social pressure point most likely to move an elite negotiator.

entries.name: Noise Filter
entries.summary: You mentally suppress steady background noise and pick out one changing sound source, conversation, rhythm, or warning signal in a crowded environment.

entries.name: Noonfield
entries.summary: You establish a brilliant zone of direct solar pressure that weakens shadow, exposes concealment, purifies minor corruption, and makes stealth difficult for everyone inside.

entries.name: Oath Sense
entries.summary: You feel the presence of a serious sworn promise, magically witnessed agreement, or recent oath-breaking around a person, object, or place. It does not reveal every clause automatically.

entries.name: Oath Unbroken
entries.summary: Channel the wielder's current mana through the Argent Heart and choose one manifestation: Argent Bastion raises a protective dome centered on the wielder that moves with them and shields everyone within, with its size, resilience, and duration increasing according to the mana committed; Vowpiercer condenses the same power into one enhanced attack that bypasses armor, resistances, and immunities to strike the target directly. The narrator must reduce the wielder's current mana according to the chosen manifestation, its scale, and the opposition it overcomes, with prolonged defense or attacks against exceptionally powerful protections capable of exhausting the wielder completely.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: Wielder of the Argent Vow 1, mana 1

entries.name: Oathbind Clause
entries.summary: You place magical weight on a spoken agreement, duel term, promise, contract, or witnessed declaration whose terms are actually spoken, understood, and meaningfully accepted. The magic strengthens or witnesses the commitment that was made; it cannot invent consent, add unstated obligations, or turn an arbitrary command into an oath.

entries.name: Object Sense
entries.summary: Handle a strange item carefully enough to notice age, purpose, danger, and signs of use. Reveals whether a relic is safe to keep touching.

entries.name: Omen Reading
entries.summary: Read a troubling sign, taboo symbol, curse mark, or unnatural coincidence before others dismiss it. Reveals the kind of danger the omen points toward.

entries.name: Omen Thread
entries.summary: You sense the pressure of a likely turning point: a lucky opening, a cursed step, a meeting that matters, or a choice that will echo. Use this to notice danger before it arrives or choose between paths with a faint sense of consequence.

entries.name: One-Hand Traverse
entries.summary: You move across broken walls, rigging, cliffs, roofs, or chains while keeping one hand free for action. Lets you fight, rescue, carry, or manipulate objects during a climb.

entries.name: One-Will Crew
entries.summary: You make oars, crew, current, and hull act like one will in impossible water. Can carry a boat through legendary weather, battle, or monster-driven chaos if the vessel can physically survive.

entries.name: Oneiric Kingdom
entries.summary: You stabilize a vast shared dream-space with persistent rules, geography, and symbolic structure for one major dream scene. Willing visitors can explore, communicate, and leave by waking or ending their participation.

entries.name: Opening Feint
entries.summary: Draw an opponent into guarding the wrong line with posture and blade pressure. Creates a clean opening for a follow-up strike, disarm, or reposition.

entries.name: Operational Command
entries.summary: You turn a complicated objective into coordinated phases, reserves, signals, fallback positions, and responsibilities for a sizeable force or expedition.

entries.name: Ossuary Command
entries.summary: You command loose skeletal or fossil material across a dangerous scene, raising barriers, breaking or restraining skeletal constructs, reshaping an ossuary, or redirecting scattered bone material. The effect is conspicuous and supernatural but does not force a living body to answer its own skeleton.

entries.name: Overdrive Burst
entries.summary: You release a focused burst of arcane overdrive through your body, weapon, shield, or active spell, letting one action break resistance, endure backlash, or land with abnormal impact.

entries.name: Overpressure Field
entries.summary: You radiate unstable amplifying pressure around yourself, strengthening allied impacts and your own exertion while making uncontrolled collisions more dangerous. Its broad benefit trades precision for coverage.

entries.name: Overwatch Field
entries.summary: Hold a lane with such clear aim that enemies must choose between delay, cover, or being shot. Controls a visible approach until your attention is broken.

entries.name: Pack Bond
entries.summary: You form a temporary magical bond with one or more beasts, allowing complex direction, danger awareness, and brief perception sharing. Use this to coordinate scouting, hunting, pursuit, protection, or mounted cooperation.

entries.name: Pack Signal
entries.summary: Coordinate trained animals, mounts, or allied beasts with clear calls and timing. Improves group animal coordination and protects against confusion.

entries.name: Packmaster Signals
entries.summary: You coordinate several animals or mounts as one pack through signals, spacing, and dominance cues. Lets them scout, protect, herd, pursue, or carry allies without collapsing into confusion.

entries.name: Packmind Chorus
entries.summary: You link the awareness of several willing beasts or bonded companions into one shared danger sense. The group can coordinate pursuit, warning, and positioning without becoming a telepathic hive.

entries.name: Pain Momentum
entries.summary: Use pain and impact as fuel instead of losing tempo. Carries advantage into the next close physical action after taking or dealing a hard hit.

entries.name: Pain Partition
entries.summary: You isolate pain and sickness from judgment through discipline and bodily familiarity. Prevents a harmful condition from ruining a precise action at the critical moment.

entries.name: Palimpsest of Time
entries.summary: You expose multiple layers of powerful echoes across a major location, letting past events overlap the present as visible or audible impressions. The display is interpretive, emotionally colored, and not literal time travel.

entries.name: Palm Switch
entries.summary: You move a small object from hand, sleeve, belt, pouch, or table during a moment of divided attention. Can plant, palm, swap, or retrieve an item without making the motion the focus of the scene.

entries.name: Palm the Evidence
entries.summary: Exchange, conceal, or recover one small object during an active social moment without making the hand movement the center of attention. It requires physical access and does not defeat direct scrutiny automatically.

entries.name: Panic Turn
entries.summary: You break an animal's fear spiral by matching its instinct before redirecting it. Can turn bolting, aggression, or freezing into movement, guarding, or retreat when trust or training exists.

entries.name: Paper Trail of Power
entries.summary: Connect records, appointments, payments, correspondence, and faction structure to identify who materially benefited from a decision or sequence of decisions. It produces a supported political lead, not proof beyond the documents.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: Political Archivist 1, Faction Lore 30, Archival Research 30

entries.name: Parable Guidance
entries.summary: Tell a story or lesson that mirrors the current dilemma closely enough to give listeners a clue, warning, or new interpretation. Delivers a clue or warning indirectly without forcing another character’s decision.

entries.name: Passing Volley
entries.summary: Release a thrown weapon during a fast pass and keep moving through the exchange, using the mount to create and leave the throwing window. It trades a stationary setup for mobility rather than guaranteeing a hit.

entries.name: Patient Negotiation
entries.summary: Wait out bluster, silence, insult, or evasion until the other party overcommits or reveals need. Draws out need, overreach, or contradiction by waiting through evasion.

entries.name: Patient Status Pressure
entries.summary: Wait through denial and polite evasion until a rival, petitioner, or subordinate exposes need, weakness, or overreach. Waits out evasion until a rival, petitioner, or subordinate exposes weakness.

entries.name: Patron's Shield
entries.summary: Use hospitality, sponsorship, or formal explanation to shield someone briefly from gossip or public suspicion. Buys time before reputation damage fully lands.

entries.name: Pattern Break
entries.summary: Identify the one object, gap, repetition, or physical inconsistency that deserves closer examination in a cluttered scene. It narrows the search to a meaningful anomaly rather than revealing hidden truth automatically.

entries.name: Pattern Key
entries.summary: You notice repeated symbols, spacing, substitutions, or structural habits in an encoded text. It tells you what kind of cipher you may be facing and where to start.

entries.name: Pattern Reading
entries.summary: Read behavior, timing, repeated symbols, and social pressure to infer likely consequences; this is uncanny insight, not guaranteed prophecy. Reveals likely consequences from behavior, timing, symbols, and social pressure.

entries.name: Pattern Snare
entries.summary: You bind a dangerous repeating pattern to a narrow condition so it cannot express itself freely for a time. The snare contains the story pressure rather than erasing the underlying curse or fate.

entries.name: Peaceweaver Moment
entries.summary: You create a narrow opening where enemies, rivals, or frightened parties can speak without losing face. Use this to stop escalation, preserve a fragile alliance, calm a diplomatic crisis, or keep a meeting from collapsing.

entries.name: Perfect Arcane Fusion
entries.summary: Act as one continuous line of intent where blade, breath, body, and magic no longer compete. Enables a masterful martial-magical action if the character already has the required magical source.

entries.name: Perfect Charge
entries.summary: Align mount, rider, weapon, terrain, and timing into one decisive impact. Can break an ordinary formation or decide a mounted exchange if the path is possible.

entries.name: Perfect Court Mask
entries.summary: You move through conflicting ranks, customs, ceremonies, and hostile scrutiny without giving observers an easy procedural weakness to exploit. Use this to remain composed across an exceptionally difficult court scene; it cannot counterfeit legal status or personal relationships.

entries.name: Perfect Distance
entries.summary: Read distance, rhythm, and intent so completely that one exchange can decide the duel. Bypasses ordinary guard on a successful decisive strike but not supernatural protection.

entries.name: Perfect Kill Window
entries.summary: Wait for the exact instant when body, attention, protection, and escape all fail together. Can end a mundane target in one prepared strike if the scene truly supports assassination.

entries.name: Perfect Measure
entries.summary: You impose the rules of the duel through footwork, tempo, and threat until the opponent must answer on your terms. Can turn one formal or single-combat scene into a decisive contest of your chosen measure.

entries.name: Perfect Motion
entries.summary: You take extraordinary control of one continuous movement sequence, preserving momentum through turns, impacts, leaps, and transitions that should normally break it. The effect rewards a coherent path rather than granting arbitrary speed.

entries.name: Perfect Reinforcement
entries.summary: Drive raw magical pressure through one difficult physical or magical action while distributing the strain so the effort does not immediately tear apart the body, tool, weapon, or spell structure carrying it. It amplifies an existing action and never replaces the underlying skill.

entries.name: Perfect Simulacrum
entries.summary: You create an almost complete false person, creature, object, or environment that behaves convincingly for a major scene. Use this to deceive, redirect, or protect, but hostile intent, touch, wards, or careful contradiction can break it.

entries.name: Perfect Stroke
entries.summary: Commit to a single masterful cut that answers guard, distance, and timing at once. Can decide a mundane melee exchange unless the target has exceptional defense or supernatural protection.

entries.name: Period Tell
entries.summary: You recognize a common historical style, date range, ruler, war, institution, or cultural feature from clothing, architecture, coinage, language, or objects.

entries.name: Permanent Mark
entries.summary: You inscribe or fix a durable enchantment that can persist without constant concentration. Use this to create a lasting ward, binding, item function, or magical condition, but complex marks require time, materials, and clear terms.

entries.name: Pestilent Season
entries.summary: You impose a severe bounded blight across a large prepared area, accelerating rot, feverish weakness, and corrupted growth. It is intentionally limited by boundary and duration rather than becoming an uncontrolled world plague.

entries.name: Phantom Terrain
entries.summary: You overlay a substantial patch of terrain with convincing false walls, paths, hazards, cover, or open space. The illusion can redirect movement until physical interaction exposes the lie.

entries.name: Phase Shift
entries.summary: Draw on one lunar aspect—concealment, silver revelation, instinct, tide, transformation, or night-sense—and let it dominate your Arcana expression for a scene. The chosen phase sharpens that domain while leaving its ordinary limits and consequences intact.

entries.name: Phoenix Surge
entries.summary: You rise through pain, ash, or defeat with cleansing fire around you. Use this to stand after being wounded, purge a harmful effect, protect an ally through radiant flame, recover momentum, or burn corruption from a scene.

entries.name: Pilgrim Presence
entries.summary: Calm pilgrims, travelers, guards, or frightened commoners by turning a dangerous march or crisis into a shared duty. Calms frightened travelers by framing hardship as shared duty.

entries.name: Pine's Endurance
entries.summary: You awaken the Pine within the Luporian medallion and force your body to remain functional through one immediate physical hardship that would otherwise hinder or stop you. Use this to keep moving or acting through exhaustion, severe cold or heat, pain, sickness, poison symptoms, deprivation, or comparable bodily strain for the present action without curing the underlying condition. The hardship remains and resumes affecting you afterward.

entries.name: Pinning Bolt
entries.summary: You place a bolt to pin cloth, gear, shield edge, wing, or limb to the environment instead of merely wounding. Can briefly halt movement or prevent pursuit when the shot lands cleanly.

entries.name: Pinning Shot
entries.summary: Place an arrow where movement becomes dangerous instead of merely aiming to wound. Can pin clothing, gear, cover, or escape routes when the shot is plausible.

entries.name: Pitmaster's Circle
entries.summary: You turn a melee scrum into your ring, breaking grips, redirecting bodies, and throwing enemies into each other. Can control several nearby opponents through position and leverage if they can physically be moved.

entries.name: Plague Vector
entries.summary: You create a bounded magical disease-vector with a defined target, trigger, and short lifespan. It is feared, illegal, and morally dangerous; it should never become an uncontrolled world plague unless the story deliberately escalates.

entries.name: Planar Wrongness
entries.summary: You notice when space, distance, reflection, gravity, or atmosphere feels subtly wrong. Use this to detect planar influence, unstable thresholds, strange rooms, or places where reality is thin.

entries.name: Plausible Omission
entries.summary: You answer truthfully around the part you need hidden, shaping emphasis and detail so the omission feels natural without creating a complicated false story.

entries.name: Pocket Space
entries.summary: You fold a small extradimensional storage space into reach, large enough for satchel-scale gear, documents, tools, or small valuables. The space is unstable under unconsciousness, suppression, or spatial interference.

entries.name: Pocket Vanish
entries.summary: You slip into a small blind spot before attention fully lands on you. Use this to hide briefly, pass through a crowd, break line of sight, or reposition without becoming the center of the scene.

entries.name: Poisoned Courtesy
entries.summary: Make a polite exchange feel unsafe enough that weaker opponents reveal more than intended. Makes politeness feel dangerous enough that weaker opponents reveal too much.

entries.name: Poisoned Edge
entries.summary: Apply a prepared toxin, irritant, or disabling substance to a blade without wasting the opening. Delivers the substance cleanly if the strike lands.

entries.name: Polar Cataclysm
entries.summary: You unleash a violent magnetic inversion through a metal-heavy scene, sending weapons, armor, chains, gates, tools, and debris into sudden attraction or repulsion. It affects allies and the environment unless carefully placed.

entries.name: Polarity Cage
entries.summary: You establish opposed magnetic fields that trap, repel, or pin metal-bearing targets and equipment within a zone. Strong nonmetal anchors or magical resistance can break the geometry.

entries.name: Polebreak Storm
entries.summary: You unleash violent shifting attraction and repulsion across a large area, ripping loose metal, disrupting formations, and turning armored movement hazardous. The field is broad and difficult to use around allies.

entries.name: Polite Refusal
entries.summary: Refuse a request so gracefully that pushing harder makes the petitioner look crude, unsafe, or politically careless. Blocks a request while making further pressure socially costly.

entries.name: Polite Trap
entries.summary: Use correct forms, precedence, and courtesy to place someone in a social position where overreach, ignorance, or bad faith becomes harder to hide without an awkward refusal or contradiction. It creates formal pressure rather than forcing disclosure or reading hidden intent.

entries.name: Power Overwhelming
entries.summary: You flood your body, weapon, shield, or active spell with raw arcane output, magnifying impact, endurance, and exertion until resistance gives way. Use this to overpower a major defense, hold through impossible strain, or stabilize an extreme effort at visible cost.

entries.name: Power Surge
entries.summary: You drive raw arcane output into one immediate action, making a strike, leap, block, shove, spell impact, or desperate exertion exceed normal limits.

entries.name: Power Web
entries.summary: You reconstruct a complex network of faction influence, proxy relationships, hidden dependencies, and competing interests from scattered credible evidence without assuming every connection is centrally controlled.

entries.name: Practical Command Voice
entries.summary: Cut through panic with direct practical orders that people can immediately understand and obey. Cuts through panic with immediately actionable orders.

entries.name: Prayer Spark
entries.summary: You shape a small prayer, blessing, or sacred phrase into emotional steadiness. Use this to calm fear, perform a simple rite, offer comfort, or focus yourself through faith.

entries.name: Precedent Recall
entries.summary: You recall a relevant past event, treaty, succession, disaster, rebellion, or institutional response that provides useful context for the present situation.

entries.name: Predator Mantle
entries.summary: You take on a focused predatory aspect such as claws, padded movement, scent tracking, burst speed, or low-light sight. Choose a coherent animal trait package rather than gaining every beast advantage at once.

entries.name: Predatory Senses
entries.summary: Your undead senses sharpen around blood, fear, breath, warmth, heartbeat, and movement in darkness. Use this to track living prey, notice hidden creatures, read physical fear, sense fresh blood, or act in darkness where mortal sight fails.

entries.name: Prepared Cover Story
entries.summary: Maintain one substantial false identity through appearance, remembered details, routine questions, and controlled correction when small inconsistencies appear. It does not survive records or witnesses that directly prove the identity false.

entries.name: Prepared Kill Zone
entries.summary: Pre-sight a narrow approach, doorway, bridge, or exposed mechanism so the next target entering that prepared line can be engaged immediately. Preparation matters; the technique does not create sightlines that are not there.

entries.name: Prepared Quiet Exit
entries.summary: Leave a room, alley, meeting, or social trap before attention settles, provided a plausible exit was prepared or previously established. Allows escape from a room, alley, meeting, or social trap when an exit was prepared.

entries.name: Pressure Bet
entries.summary: You create table pressure through timing, silence, false confidence, and visible risk. Can force a nervous opponent to reveal whether they are bluffing or protecting something.

entries.name: Pressure Cleave
entries.summary: You commit a heavy cut through the line where guard, armor posture, and fear meet. Can force a defended enemy to give ground or lose their guard.

entries.name: Pressure Lance
entries.summary: You compress air into a narrow invisible thrust that strikes like a piercing battering ram. It can punch through a small opening, stagger a distant target, or break a fragile obstruction.

entries.name: Pressure Mantle
entries.summary: Wrap a person, vessel, or small group in circulating water pressure that cushions impact, redirects loose projectiles, stabilizes movement, and resists surrounding currents. It requires sufficient water and cannot simply ignore crushing force or powerful magic.

entries.name: Pressure Map
entries.summary: Identify who benefits, who fears discovery, who had access, and who is being protected. Turns scattered motives into a usable suspect structure.

entries.name: Pressure Point
entries.summary: Identify and apply psychological pressure on a subject to extract information. Most effective on targets who are already afraid, conflicted, or poorly prepared to resist.

entries.name: Pressure Shell
entries.summary: Wrap yourself and nearby allies in a shifting shell of controlled air pressure that deflects loose missiles, softens impacts, parts smoke or gas, and resists wind from every direction. It is broad protection, not an absolute barrier against overwhelming force.

entries.name: Pressure the Inconsistency
entries.summary: Return to one contradiction from a different social angle until the witness must clarify, retreat, redirect, or reveal why the point is uncomfortable. It does not force truthful confession.

entries.name: Price the Secret
entries.summary: Judge whether a source is more likely to move for coin, protection, revenge, access, anonymity, reputation, or another kind of payment before making the approach. It reveals the likely currency of the conversation, not the secret itself.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: Information Broker 1, Social Inquiry 30, Thieves' Lore 30

entries.name: Primal Accord
entries.summary: Reach a dangerous creature through instinct, dominance, calm, or deep animal understanding when violence has not become unavoidable. Can halt or redirect a beast encounter if the creature has a real instinctive reason to listen.

entries.name: Primeval Aspect
entries.summary: You assume a powerful mythic beast aspect rooted in a creature you know deeply. It can grant extraordinary movement, natural weapons, senses, or endurance, but remains limited by that beast nature and the scene.

entries.name: Principle Severance
entries.summary: You strike into the governing law of powerful magic and cut the principle holding it together. Use this to unravel major spells, break dangerous wards, expose ritual cores, or create a decisive opening against supernatural force.

entries.name: Prism Ward
entries.summary: You create a faceted barrier that splits light, energy, and magical pressure into several directions. It offers broad protection but can produce dangerous reflections or focused spill.

entries.name: Prismatic Screen
entries.summary: You bend light around a small area into glare, refraction, and shifting color. It can spoil aim, hide precise movement, or protect eyes from hostile brilliance without creating true darkness.

entries.name: Private Confidence
entries.summary: You turn mutual interest into a quieter conversation, dance, walk, or personal exchange where trust can deepen naturally. Creates room for connection through rapport, not pressure.

entries.name: Private Meeting Arrangement
entries.summary: Arrange a private conversation, intercepted message, quiet meeting, or controlled encounter under cover of routine. Creates a controlled private encounter or message handoff under routine cover.

entries.name: Private Salon Interrogation
entries.summary: Extract admissions through hospitality, silence, careful seating, indirect questions, and controlled privacy. Extracts admissions through controlled hospitality and indirect questioning.

entries.name: Procedural Trap
entries.summary: Let a dishonest official, witness, or negotiator continue speaking until their own formal wording creates a contradiction. Creates a contradiction by letting a dishonest speaker overcommit in formal wording.

entries.name: Processional Command
entries.summary: Organize movement, watches, supplies, spacing, and protective order for large groups traveling through hostile or uncertain territory. Organizes movement, watch order, supplies, and protective spacing for a large group.

entries.name: Protective Custody
entries.summary: Separate a vulnerable person, suspicious traveler, or needed witness from a group under safety, law, command, or emergency necessity. Separates a vulnerable person, witness, or suspect under safety or command authority.

entries.name: Protective Formation
entries.summary: Organize guards, allies, civilians, pilgrims, or frightened bystanders into a defensive formation that reduces panic and blocks pursuit. Creates a guarded formation that protects a group and blocks pursuit through constrained terrain.

entries.name: Protocol Reversal
entries.summary: Use the exact rules of a formal setting to force a demand, insult, or irregular procedure back into a form that can be challenged or answered safely. It works only where the relevant protocol has real standing.

entries.name: Provenance Thread
entries.summary: Trace clues of maker, owner, culture, or route from material, style, damage, and inscriptions. Reveals where a relic likely came from or who valued it.

entries.name: Proxy Read
entries.summary: You recognize when an apparently independent group, merchant, scholar, mercenary, or official is likely acting as a proxy for a larger faction based on methods and incentives.

entries.name: Public Reassurance, Private Warning
entries.summary: Offer visible reassurance, blessing, toast, or formal statement that calms witnesses while quietly warning one person of danger. Calms witnesses while delivering one quiet warning to the intended person.

entries.name: Pulse Command
entries.summary: You read and carefully guide the movement of blood in yourself or a willing patient, slowing bleeding, supporting circulation, steadying a faltering pulse, or helping the body resist poison and shock. It cannot disrupt circulation, inflict injury, or control the body of an unwilling target.

entries.name: Pulse Through Stone
entries.summary: With sustained contact, you follow faint transmitted vibrations through walls, floors, hulls, or earth to locate significant movement or mechanical activity beyond direct sight.

entries.name: Punishment Economy
entries.summary: Identify which punishment, reward, ration, promotion, relief, or pressure will move a group without wasting resources. Identifies the pressure, reward, ration, or relief that moves a group efficiently.

entries.name: Purge Toxin
entries.summary: You draw a poison, venom, or harmful alchemical contaminant toward the surface and weaken its effect. Severe toxins may require repeated treatment, an antidote, or mundane medicine as well.

entries.name: Pursuit Breaker
entries.summary: You break a pursuit by choosing the one route that punishes heavier, slower, or less prepared followers. Can force pursuers to lose ground unless they match your mobility or planning.

entries.name: Put It on the Record
entries.summary: Frame a public or formal argument in terms the surrounding culture recognizes strongly enough that an authority, institution, or audience must acknowledge the issue rather than quietly ignoring it. They may answer against you.

entries.name: Quality Tell
entries.summary: You identify the clearest sign of workmanship, wear, substitution, repair, or counterfeit quality in a common object before agreeing on value.

entries.name: Quarantine Circle
entries.summary: You mark a small boundary that suppresses the spread of disease, magical rot, spores, or contaminated organic matter across it for a limited time.

entries.name: Question Chain
entries.summary: Ask questions in an order that makes rehearsed answers strain against each other. Exposes one weak point in a false or incomplete account.

entries.name: Question the Pattern
entries.summary: Focus divination on the physical evidence already present to identify which lead, object, route, or contradiction is most likely to matter next. It points toward a useful question rather than supplying the final answer.

entries.name: Quick Draught
entries.summary: Mix a simple draught, solvent, scent, smoke, or stimulant from prepared ingredients under pressure. Produces a small practical effect suited to the materials on hand.

entries.name: Quick Draw
entries.summary: Bring a small weapon into motion before the target fully understands the threat. Enables a sudden thrown attack during movement or conversation.

entries.name: Quick Imbuement
entries.summary: You place a short-lived magical quality on an ordinary object, such as grip, sharpness, warmth, resistance, light, or a simple response. The effect is temporary and cannot imitate a complex relic.

entries.name: Quick Set
entries.summary: You open a straightforward mundane lock quickly with proper tools when there is pressure to avoid delay, but complex traps or unusual mechanisms still require care.

entries.name: Quick Stitch
entries.summary: You rapidly draw existing fibers back into a damaged weave, closing tears, restoring seams, splicing rope, or reinforcing a weakened section. Missing material is not replaced, and this repairs fiber rather than wounds or unrelated materials.

entries.name: Quickdraw Beat
entries.summary: Your hand moves before hesitation costs you the moment. Use this to draw a weapon, ready a tool, throw a small object, or react quickly when sudden danger appears.

entries.name: Quiet the Restless
entries.summary: Use rite, name, offering, or correct words to calm a minor restless presence. Reduces haunting pressure long enough for speech, passage, or repair.

entries.name: Radiant Recovery
entries.summary: You time healing, breath, and movement so recovery happens without losing the flow of danger. Use this to mend serious harm, purge a minor condition, restore momentum after injury, or keep an ally acting through pain.

entries.name: Radiant Veil
entries.summary: You bend light around yourself, an ally, or a small area, creating glare, concealment, shifting silhouettes, or blinding reflection. Use this to hinder aim, hide movement, expose invisible outlines, or protect against darkness-based concealment.

entries.name: Rain of Falling Crowns
entries.summary: You turn ranged attacks into a masterful storm that controls where enemies can stand. Use this to pin a formation, protect allies, punish clustered enemies, or dominate a battlefield lane.

entries.name: Raincaller
entries.summary: You gather available moisture into a localized burst of rain or intensify existing rainfall over a small area. Dry air and enclosed spaces sharply limit the effect.

entries.name: Raise Dead
entries.summary: You animate one recently dead body as a temporary undead servant or battlefield obstacle. Use this to create a brief distraction, guard, carrier, or source of tactical pressure, but the act is limited, socially dangerous, and cannot restore the original person.

entries.name: Rally
entries.summary: Steady or re-energize allies who are flagging, frightened, or uncertain. Restores resolve and direction. Most effective when the situation is hard but not hopeless.

entries.name: Rally Order
entries.summary: Cut through fear and confusion with a clear order that gives allies something immediate to do. Restores group focus and improves the next coordinated action.

entries.name: Rapid Brace
entries.summary: Shape nearby earth or workable stone into a temporary brace, footing, berm, plug, or support around an understood structural problem. The result follows the available material and does not become instant finished architecture.

entries.name: Rare Reagent Read
entries.summary: You recognize subtle traces of rare herbs, minerals, magical ingredients, aged preparations, and unusual contaminants in a safely testable sample.

entries.name: Read the Fracture
entries.summary: Identify the hidden stress line in a metal structure, weapon, mechanism, or fitting and choose whether to reinforce it or exploit it with a precise intervention. It turns material knowledge into a targeted structural option.

entries.name: Read the Living System
entries.summary: Use several natural signs together to predict one likely environmental development such as weather shift, animal movement, contamination, or ecological danger. It provides a grounded forecast, not supernatural certainty.

entries.name: Read the Pressure Road
entries.summary: Use air movement, pressure, cloud behavior, and route knowledge to anticipate one dangerous weather or travel shift before it fully develops. It can reveal a safer timing or direction, not command the storm itself.

entries.name: Read the Real Price
entries.summary: Identify the non-monetary pressure actually driving a negotiation, such as time, risk, reputation, shortage, or obligation. It reveals a likely leverage point, not an automatic winning offer.

entries.name: Read the Warning Backwards
entries.summary: Use the way a relic, text, or site was suppressed to infer what earlier custodians feared people would do with it. The method reveals a likely danger or temptation without safely teaching the forbidden act itself.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: Forbidden Antiquarian 1, Forbidden Lore 30, Relic Lore 30

entries.name: Rebirth Pyre
entries.summary: You create a prepared phoenix rite around someone at the edge of death, burning away catastrophic injury and rekindling life if their soul and body have not passed beyond recovery. It is not casual resurrection and demands major consequence.

entries.name: Rebound Step
entries.summary: You rebound from wall, branch, shield, creature, or falling debris to change direction mid-movement. Can reach places or angles that a normal jump cannot.

entries.name: Rebounding Ward
entries.summary: You shape a barrier to redirect part of an incoming impact, projectile, or spell away from the protected target. The redirected force follows plausible angles and can still create collateral danger.

entries.name: Rebuke the Profane
entries.summary: Answer blasphemy, cruelty, corruption, or profanation with unwavering doctrine and moral clarity. Use this to challenge, shame, or unsettle someone who cares about the faith, oath, community, or moral standard being invoked; Faith alone does not repel undead or create sacred force.

entries.name: Recall Thread
entries.summary: You anchor one chosen memory in yourself or a willing target so it can be recalled clearly through stress, sleep, fear, or distraction for a limited period.

entries.name: Recall the Bound
entries.summary: Call one creature, construct, servant, or conjured object that you already summoned or properly bound back to your immediate vicinity through its existing connection. This cannot seize an unrelated being or bypass a broken binding, ward, or severed link.

entries.name: Reconstruct the Trail
entries.summary: Combine scattered signs into a plausible sequence of movement even after part of a trail is damaged, crossed, or deliberately obscured. It yields a reasoned route, not certainty where evidence is absent.

entries.name: Recover the Point
entries.summary: Recover a lance after impact without losing the weapon line or becoming helplessly overextended, allowing a guarded withdrawal, wheel, or second threat. It does not erase the need for space and mount control.

entries.name: Recovery Wheel
entries.summary: You recover the lance line after impact instead of becoming overextended. Lets you wheel, guard, or strike again during a mounted exchange.

entries.name: Redline Maneuver
entries.summary: You push a craft past safe handling for one controlled burst without losing it. Enables a hard escape, interception, landing, or rescue at serious strain to the vehicle.

entries.name: Reefing Drill
entries.summary: You shorten, spill, or reset sail quickly when wind, current, or vessel angle turns dangerous. Use this to preserve control through a sudden gust, reduce rigging strain, or prepare for a hard turn without pretending the ship can ignore weather.

entries.name: Reflected Counter
entries.summary: Catch one visible effect, image, beam, gaze, or line of magical influence through a suitable reflective surface and redirect its apparent or magical path. The mirror must be capable of carrying the interaction; not every force or spell can be reflected.

entries.name: Reflective Ward
entries.summary: You angle a reflective surface or magical sheen to turn glare, sight-based magic, or a narrow energy attack away from its original line. The reflection follows plausible geometry.

entries.name: Refusal Wall
entries.summary: You raise a barrier defined by one purpose such as stopping a charge, spellfire, projectiles, or intrusion. It becomes exceptionally strong against that declared pressure but less useful against unrelated threats.

entries.name: Regional Route Rewrite
entries.summary: You turn incomplete maps, ancient routes, terrain logic, and visible landmarks into a strategic travel advantage. Use this to reveal hidden paths, expose false maps, chart safe passage, or plan movement through an entire region.

entries.name: Rein Recovery
entries.summary: You take control of reins, wheels, runners, or harness before panic spreads through the vehicle. Prevents a simple road hazard from becoming a crash.

entries.name: Reinforced Motion
entries.summary: You feed raw magical output into one physical action already underway, helping a shove, block, climb, leap, strike, or lift exceed ordinary effort without replacing the underlying skill.

entries.name: Rekindle Life
entries.summary: You pour restorative magic into someone at the brink of death, restoring failing breath, circulation, and damaged function if life has not fully departed. It cannot casually resurrect someone already truly dead.

entries.name: Relentless Pursuit
entries.summary: Keep pressure on a quarry across fatigue, false trails, and attempted misdirection. Denies ordinary escape through endurance and trail reading.

entries.name: Relic Soul Awakening
entries.summary: You separate the deepest intended function of an artifact from later repairs, curses, false bindings, and accumulated emotional residue. Use this to expose a relic’s true operating principle, identify a dormant capability, or determine the precise condition that could awaken it without automatically forcing that awakening.

entries.name: Relic Soul Resonance
entries.summary: You read the purpose, danger, emotional history, and dormant functions impressed into an unusual object, separating its normal use from curses, later alterations, and sleeping mechanisms. Use this to identify what a relic expects from a bearer and what conditions may safely make it respond.

entries.name: Remote Mark
entries.summary: You place a subtle divinatory link on a willing person, object, or location you can reach. Later you can sense its rough direction, condition, or disturbance unless wards or distance sever the connection.

entries.name: Repulsion Dome
entries.summary: You push outward in every direction around a protected point, resisting charges, thrown objects, and nearby bodies. The broad defense is less precise than a focused force strike.

entries.name: Reputation Shelter
entries.summary: Temporarily shield a favored person from gossip or suspicion through hospitality, patronage, family explanation, or official protection. Temporarily shields a target from gossip or public suspicion through patronage or hospitality.

entries.name: Rescue Hold
entries.summary: You rescue another person in dangerous water without letting their panic drown you both. Stabilizes one struggling target and moves them toward safety.

entries.name: Rescue Stroke
entries.summary: Reach and support another swimmer, wounded person, or burden in bad water without immediately losing your own control. It improves a rescue attempt but cannot defeat impossible currents or weight.

entries.name: Reserve Sprint
entries.summary: Spend carefully preserved pace on one decisive burst during a chase, escape, rescue, or race without treating the whole journey as a sprint. It creates a short window of exceptional speed at a real stamina cost.

entries.name: Reservoir Facet
entries.summary: Shape a prepared crystal into a temporary reservoir for one bounded magical charge, sensory impression, or simple Arcana effect that can be released later under a clear condition. Capacity, stability, and the original effect limit what the crystal can hold.

entries.name: Residual Sequence
entries.summary: Combine physical clues with magical structure to reconstruct the likely order in which several magical events occurred. It reveals a reasoned sequence from evidence, not the hidden motives of whoever caused it.

entries.name: Resonance Dome
entries.summary: You establish a field that absorbs, redirects, or cancels hostile sound from many directions while allowing chosen communication inside. Extreme vibration can overwhelm it.

entries.name: Resonance Strike
entries.summary: You focus sonic vibration into a body, object, barrier, weapon, or structure. Use this to shatter brittle material, disrupt concentration, stagger a target, expose hidden hollows, or weaken something by resonance.

entries.name: Resonant Shard
entries.summary: You grow a tuned crystal shard that stores a brief sound, light, spell pulse, or sensory impression. It can later release that single captured pattern once.

entries.name: Resonant Trace
entries.summary: You isolate one voice, emotion, impact, spell, or movement from a confused magical echo. The result remains fragmentary and cannot become a perfect recording.

entries.name: Resource Ledger Insight
entries.summary: Notice when a shipment, harvest, route, resource tally, cargo manifest, or local ledger has been altered or misreported. Reveals altered shipments, harvests, manifests, or resource records.

entries.name: Restorative Field
entries.summary: You spread healing pressure through a small group, stabilizing bleeding, shock, pain, and minor wounds at once. Its broad coverage is less precise than focused treatment of one patient.

entries.name: Restorative Meal
entries.summary: Prepare food that meaningfully restores stamina and morale when time and ingredients allow. Produces more effective rest recovery than standard rations.

entries.name: Restore the Line
entries.summary: Reorganize a scattered, frightened, or confused group around one immediate objective and clear roles. It can restore coordinated action when people still have reason to follow, not create loyalty from nothing.

entries.name: Restore the Missing
entries.summary: Reconstruct a damaged or incomplete memory in yourself or a willing target from surviving fragments, associated senses, records, and emotional anchors. The result can recover lost continuity but cannot fabricate certainty where the underlying memory was never formed or has been completely destroyed.

entries.name: Returning Guard
entries.summary: You recover an axe from a committed cut into a hook, haft block, or shoulder guard, reducing the opening that normally follows a heavy swing.

entries.name: Revelation Field
entries.summary: You flood an area with uncompromising light that suppresses mundane concealment and makes visual distortions, shadows, hidden markings, and many illusions easier to expose.

entries.name: Reverse Trigger
entries.summary: Turn a discovered trap timing, direction, or trigger against someone else. Re-aims or delays a trap when the mechanism allows manipulation.

entries.name: Rewrite Condition
entries.summary: Alter one understood trigger, exception, target, duration condition, or response inside an enchantment you can safely access. You must comprehend the existing working; this cannot casually seize ownership of unknown relics or rewrite effects beyond the enchantment's established function.

entries.name: Rewrite the Knot
entries.summary: You intervene at a major fate-knot and alter one relationship between promise, curse, prophecy, and consequence. The pattern resists, demands a plausible new path, and may shift cost rather than simply disappear.

entries.name: Ricochet Cast
entries.summary: You bounce or curve a sling stone through terrain, walls, shields, or ground angle to hit from an unexpected direction. Can reach targets that ordinary straight fire cannot.

entries.name: Ricochet Line
entries.summary: Use wall, shield edge, stone, or furniture to alter a thrown weapon path. Reaches targets protected by ordinary angles when the environment supports it.

entries.name: Rightful Intercession
entries.summary: Invoke genuine recognized standing, oath, title, command relationship, or public legitimacy to force a contested action into a moment of formal acknowledgment before it proceeds. The magic magnifies rightful authority; it cannot manufacture legitimacy or compel those wholly outside its claim.

entries.name: Ring of Cinders
entries.summary: You cast a rotating wall of flame and ember around a position. It can deter approach, burn projectiles, and protect several directions, but it also creates smoke, heat, and danger for anyone crossing it.

entries.name: Ringing Break
entries.summary: Drive a controlled impact into armor, shield, weapon, or hard structure to spoil balance and leave the defended target briefly vulnerable. It converts impact into an opening instead of simply adding damage.

entries.name: Riposte Window
entries.summary: Answer a missed or poorly committed attack before the attacker fully recovers. Enables an immediate counterstroke after a successful close defense.

entries.name: Rite Structure
entries.summary: You recognize the expected sequence, roles, objects, taboos, and purpose of a common formal rite well enough to participate without obvious offense.

entries.name: Ritual Cadence
entries.summary: You recognize the musical structure of a ceremony, march, work song, lament, or magical chant and can keep a group synchronized through the expected pattern.

entries.name: Ritual Fault Line
entries.summary: Identify the step, symbol, witness role, offering, timing, or magical dependency most likely to pause or redirect an active formal ritual if disturbed correctly. Interference can still carry serious consequences.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: Ritual Scholar 1, Religious Lore 30, Arcane Lore 30

entries.name: Ritual Presence
entries.summary: Conduct or participate in formal ceremonies correctly and with authority. Enables you to lead or support oath-takings, investitures, rites, and formal proceedings.

entries.name: Road Beyond Maps
entries.summary: You maintain a coherent route through cursed paths, shifting landmarks, impossible weather, broken roads, or other travel conditions that deliberately defeat ordinary navigation, continually rebuilding position from every trustworthy cue available. It cannot create a passage where geography provides none.

entries.name: Road Memory
entries.summary: Recall old promises, forgotten names, repeated rumors, and prior turning points from travel, courts, villages, roads, or ruins. Recalls old names, promises, rumors, and turning points that add useful context.

entries.name: Road Rumor Sieve
entries.summary: Separate useful road truth from superstition, confession, gossip, rumor, and frightened exaggeration. Separates actionable local truth from gossip, fear, and superstition.

entries.name: Road's Passage
entries.summary: You awaken the Road within the Luporian medallion and commit to an immediate destination you can physically reach. For this movement, the medallion guides your footing and timing through crowds, rubble, dense undergrowth, unstable ground, cramped passages, or similar obstacles that would normally stop or severely slow you, allowing you to move through without becoming trapped or losing the route. It cannot pass through solid barriers, cross impossible gaps, ignore active restraints, or create a path where no physically possible passage exists.

entries.name: Roadthreader
entries.summary: You drive like the road bends to your will, threading impossible gaps and saving vehicle, passengers, and cargo from legendary danger. Can turn a doomed chase or crash into survival.

entries.name: Role Fit
entries.summary: You adjust clothing, posture, tools, dirt, grooming, and behavior to fit a plausible occupation or station well enough for casual passage.

entries.name: Rootstep
entries.summary: You coax roots, branches, or timber to form temporary steps, handholds, and supports beneath movement. It enables rapid climbing or crossing where living or worked wood is available.

entries.name: Rope Memory
entries.summary: Your hands remember knots, tension, and simple climbing tricks before your thoughts finish catching up. Use this to tie, secure, climb, lower, haul, or stabilize someone with rope.

entries.name: Rot Cloud
entries.summary: You gather blight into a localized cloud that weakens exposed organic matter and carries controlled contagion pressure. Wind, sealing, and protective measures can disperse or resist it.

entries.name: Rousing Verse
entries.summary: Use song, speech, rhythm, or story to steady allies before fear or fatigue takes hold. Improves morale and helps allies resist hesitation for the next action.

entries.name: Route Network Command
entries.summary: Coordinate carriers, guides, guards, local contacts, paid agents, or retainers when legitimate influence, money, rank, or prior access supports it. Creates a route-control advantage through legitimate contacts, rank, resources, or prior access.

entries.name: Route Planning
entries.summary: Plan a route or journey to minimize risk, accounting for terrain, weather, supply needs, and known hazards. Produces a safer and more efficient travel outcome.

entries.name: Route Stitch
entries.summary: You connect landmarks, slopes, roads, stars, water, and memory into a workable route. Use this to navigate unfamiliar ground, correct a wrong turn, or guide others through travel.

entries.name: Route Through History
entries.summary: Use old accounts, vanished borders, trade habits, and terrain logic to infer a forgotten road, crossing, settlement approach, or expedition route. The result is a plausible historical route that still needs present-day verification.

entries.name: Ruin Cascade
entries.summary: You push one failure into the next before the scene can recover. Use this to collapse weakened defenses, unravel unstable magic, break enemy formation, ruin a fragile mechanism, or turn existing damage into a spreading consequence.

entries.name: Ruin Fracture
entries.summary: You sense and press the weak point where structure, magic, morale, or order is already beginning to fail. Use this to crack a damaged object, worsen an unstable ward, expose a doomed plan, or make an existing fracture matter.

entries.name: Ruin Sense
entries.summary: Read a ruin, dungeon, or enclosed complex for structural risks, likely layouts, and environmental hazards before committing to a path.

entries.name: Ruin-Court Authority
entries.summary: Turn ruin, firelight, ash, banners, witnesses, old symbols, or terrified silence into a temporary court where commands feel inevitable. Turns ruins, symbols, witnesses, and fear into temporary command authority.

entries.name: Ruinfall
entries.summary: You call the end of something that was already close to breaking. Use this to destroy a major barrier, collapse a failing ritual, shatter a powerful ward, end a doomed structure, or force a fragile enemy advantage to come apart. This should create collateral risk, fear, or lasting evidence.

entries.name: Rumor Harvest
entries.summary: Extract useful information from an environment through casual conversation, listening, and rumor networks. Produces one actionable piece of local intelligence.

entries.name: Rumor Web
entries.summary: You map how one rumor travels through a group, court, market, tavern, or faction network, identifying likely sources, amplifiers, bottlenecks, and who reacts when the story reaches them. Use this to trace or redirect a limited information flow.

entries.name: Rumorstorm Seed
entries.summary: You plant a story where it will spread, mutate, and pressure the right people. Use this to bait reactions, redirect public attention, damage a reputation, protect a secret, or trace who moves when gossip lands.

entries.name: Rumorwalk
entries.summary: You become a rumor moving through the guarded place, present only in missed sounds and late discoveries. Can pass through ordinary guards, locks, and patrol logic if no supernatural barrier closes the route.

entries.name: Rune Mark
entries.summary: You inscribe a small temporary rune that nudges an object toward one simple effect. Use this to mark, reinforce, warm, cool, brighten, seal, alert, or briefly empower a mundane item.

entries.name: Rune Spark Mark
entries.summary: You place a small temporary rune mark on a surface, item, ward edge, or creature you can touch. Use this to label a target, steady a simple enchantment, trace magical structure, mark a safe path, or leave a short-lived arcane sign.

entries.name: Runebound Arsenal
entries.summary: You maintain several combat-ready runes across weapons, armor, terrain, or tools and activate them in coordinated sequence. Preparation and available surfaces determine the arsenal.

entries.name: Runic Cascade
entries.summary: Link several prepared runes into a controlled sequence so one trigger can activate, redirect, or shut down the next according to a defined order. Every rune must already be valid and prepared; this does not improvise unknown effects into existence.

entries.name: Runic Law Seal
entries.summary: You inscribe a master rune that imposes one clear magical rule on a major target, threshold, object, or area. Use this to contain a powerful threat, stabilize a ritual, reinforce a defense, or make a temporary law the scene must answer.

entries.name: Runic Lawfield
entries.summary: You inscribe or trigger a strong rune pattern that forces a rule onto the scene. Use this to seal a passage, bind a hazard, reinforce a barrier, mark an enemy, stabilize a spell, or lock an object into a temporary magical function.

entries.name: Runic Override
entries.summary: Interrupt, reroute, or temporarily suspend one understood rune-linked mechanism or ward without having to destroy the entire system. It requires access to the working structure and cannot rewrite an unknown artifact by guesswork.

entries.name: Runic Relay
entries.summary: You link several prepared runes so energy, warning, or activation can pass between them. This allows distributed wards, alarms, or chained mechanisms without granting unlimited range.

entries.name: Running Leap
entries.summary: You carry controlled speed into a jump, letting a run-up extend distance or height while preserving a safe landing plan.
